<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL parameter ordering questions, expecting a concrete example or explanation about flag/parameter behavior.

The first URL example `?foo=1&flag=true&bar=2` sets up a contrast with the second URL, implying a difference in parameter presence or ordering is being illustrated.

The final token `?flag` is the beginning of a second URL query string (`https://example.com/?flag`), requiring completion — likely `=true` or another parameter, mirroring the first example's structure but with `foo`/`bar` absent.
"Consider the following two URLs" establishes a parallel comparison structure.
"Consider the following URL: `https://example.com/?flag`" — the query string is incomplete, expecting continuation like `=true` or `&` plus other parameters referencing the "flag" mentioned earlier.</explanation>
